summary: News Corp filed an 8-K disclosing daily share repurchase information provided to the Australian Securities Exchange under its $1 billion stock repurchase program. The program authorizes the company to buy back both Class A and Class B common stock from time to time. No specific price, premium, or timeline was stated. The disclosure is a procedural update required under ASX rules. The board has not issued a formal recommendation, and no advisors are named. The mechanics involve open-market purchases subject to market conditions and regulatory limits. Watch for ongoing buyback execution and any changes in repurchase pace or program authorization.
